image_description: A grey whale is captured in the ocean, with its tail flukes raised high above the water surface as it dives. The visible portion shows the dark, mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches characteristic of the species. The broad tail flukes display a smooth trailing edge and central notch. The surrounding water shows realistic splashing and ripples around the emerging tail.
